label: Fit and size uncertainty
definition:
User doubts whether the garment will fit their body, size chart is unclear, or they hesitate between sizes.

Include: Size M vs L, measurements, body-shape fit, brand sizing inconsistency.
Exclude: Pure fabric quality complaints after purchase; delivery issues.

label: Fabric and quality doubt
definition:
User questions material, stitching, durability, or whether quality matches photos before buying.

Include: Fabric feel, transparency, stitching, dupatta quality, wash behavior.
Exclude: Post-purchase quality rants only; pure delivery complaints.

label: Styling and occasion doubt
definition:
User is unsure the item suits an occasion, outfit pairing, or personal style before committing.

Include: Occasion wear, pairing, color match, office vs party, trend doubt.
Exclude: Generic 'nice style' praise without hesitation.

label: Price level concern
definition:
User finds the absolute price too high — a level objection, not timing or value-for-money doubt.

Include: Too expensive, over budget, can't afford at current price.
Exclude: Waiting for a sale (price timing); worth-it doubt (value uncertainty).

label: Price timing — waiting for sale
definition:
User defers purchase expecting a discount, sale event, or price drop rather than rejecting value outright.

Include: Wait for sale, price watch, festive offer, end-of-season.
Exclude: Permanent 'too expensive' with no deferral cue; pure value doubt.

label: Value uncertainty — is it worth it?
definition:
User questions whether quality, brand, or utility justifies the price — distinct from absolute price level or sale timing.

Include: Worth it?, value for money, quality vs price, justify spend.
Exclude: Pure sale-waiting; simple 'too expensive' without value framing.

label: Reviews and social validation
definition:
User seeks ratings, reviews, photos from others, or social proof before buying.

Include: Review photos, ratings, influencer, friend opinion, 'has anyone bought'.
Exclude: Generic praise without validation-seeking behavior.

label: Returns and exchange risk
definition:
User hesitates because return policy, exchange hassle, or refund experience feels risky.

Include: Return policy, exchange size, refund delay, reverse pickup.
Exclude: Post-return rants with no pre-purchase decision context.

label: Delivery timing before purchase
definition:
User's pre-purchase hesitation is about when the item will arrive, not post-delivery complaints.

Include: Need before date, express delivery, ETA doubt while deciding.
Exclude: Post-delivery delay rants only.

label: Bookmark vs genuine intent
definition:
Wishlist/save behavior driven by inspiration or bookmarking rather than near-term purchase intent.

Include: Saving for later inspiration, mood board, 'maybe someday'.
Exclude: Active hesitation on a specific purchase decision.

label: Comparison and shortlist behavior
definition:
User actively compares options across products, brands, or platforms before deciding.

Include: Compare with AJIO/Amazon, shortlist two items, which one to buy.
Exclude: Single-product doubt without comparison language.

label: Post-save checkout hesitation
definition:
User saved or shortlisted but stalls at checkout or immediately after saving.

Include: Added to cart/wishlist but not buying, checkout abandoned.
Exclude: Discovery-stage browsing only.

label: Workaround instead of buying
definition:
User describes what they do instead of completing the purchase on-platform.

Include: Buy elsewhere, visit store, ask friend, screenshot and wait.
Exclude: Generic complaint without an alternative behavior.

label: General consideration job
definition:
User describes what they are trying to accomplish while shopping or shortlisting, without naming a specific doubt factor.

Include: Browsing goals, outfit planning, finding options, 'looking for'.
Exclude: Clear fit/price/styling doubt already captured elsewhere.

label: Unspecified purchase blocker
definition:
User signals something is blocking purchase without naming fit, price, or quality explicitly.

Include: Can't decide, stuck, not buying yet, something holding me back.
Exclude: Blocker with a clear decision_factor match.

label: General purchase uncertainty
definition:
User expresses doubt or hesitation without a specific factor label in the text.

Include: Not sure, confused, hesitant, don't know if I should.
Exclude: Uncertainty with explicit fit/price/styling cues.

label: Purchase trigger
definition:
An event, deal signal, or cue that pushes the user toward or away from buying now.

Include: Saw an ad, friend bought, festival coming, good deal spotted.
Exclude: Pure price-timing deferral (sale waiting).

label: Gift and occasion parking
definition:
User saves or considers an item for a gift or specific occasion rather than immediate self-purchase.

Include: Gift for someone, birthday, wedding shopping, occasion parking.
Exclude: Personal occasion styling doubt (styling_occasion_doubt).

label: Other / unmatched
definition:
Evidence that does not map cleanly to a seed code; candidates for inductive clustering.

Include: Borderline or multi-theme quotes after seed rules exhausted.
Exclude: Units that matched any other seed code.
